title: Configuration for the debit loop
statement: Given a Boolean input list $x$, a valid input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ positions, a state $q$ that is either an optional Boolean or a Boolean, an integer $z$, and a Boolean list $u$, define a configuration for the one-tape debit machine with state $q$, input-head position $p$, work tape initialized from $u$ by the machine's buffer encoding, work-head position $z$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an input-head position among $|x|+2$ positions
$q$ belongs to the disjoint union of optional Booleans and Booleans
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the buffer encoding used to initialize the work tape.
